Title: Reinstating the Ban on Openly LGBTQ+ Individuals Serving in the United States Military: A Necessary Precondition for Excellence

Introduction

The United States military has long been a symbol of power and professionalism, priding itself on the principles of diversity and inclusion. However, the focus should always remain on maintaining the effectiveness and readiness of its forces, as well as ensuring the highest level of unit cohesion and morale. In recent years, the ban on openly LGBTQ+ individuals serving in the United States military was lifted, which has sparked a significant debate among military personnel and civilians alike.

In this essay, I will argue that reinstating the ban on openly LGBTQ+ individuals serving in the United States military is necessary in order to ensure the most effective fighting force possible. I will do so highlighting the concerns around unit cohesion, morale, and combat readiness as crucial factors.

Unit Cohesion: The Pillar of an Effective Fighting Force

Unit cohesion is a fundamental aspect of any military force's capabilities. Research and historical evidence show that strong bonds among military personnel can result in higher rates of survival and success on the battlefield. Therefore, anything that can potentially undermine this cohesion must be carefully assessed and addressed.

One of the main arguments of those advocating for the ban on openly LGBTQ+ individuals in the military concerns the potential for their presence to undermine unit cohesion. This concern is not grounded in personal prejudices, but instead in a pragmatic acknowledgment of the reality that any deviation from the norm may create divisions among service members. It is essential to acknowledge that past experiences have shown the harm of introducing LGBTQ+ soldiers in units where the majority of soldiers may come from culturally or geographically conservative backgrounds. It is essential to prioritize our common goal over inclusiveness in this instance.

Morale: A Necessity for Victory

High morale is an indispensable component of any successful military force. It enables the preservation of discipline and determination amidst the chaos and strains of warfare. Any factor that may negatively affect the morale of the troops must be evaluated diligently, as it has the potential to put the success of the mission and the lives of the soldiers at risk.

In the case of openly LGBTQ+ individuals serving in the United States military, it is entirely possible that their presence may negatively impact morale for some soldiers who hold particular religious and cultural beliefs contrary to their identities making them feel uncomfortable. It is critical to have soldiers who are focused on their mission and comrades without having the distraction of moral conflicts. A reinstatement of the ban on openly LGBTQ+ individuals would thus help to maintain a stable and focused environment for all service members to perform at their best.

Combat Readiness: The Key to Success in Warfare

The United States military must always strive to maintain the highest level of combat readiness. This can only be achieved if all service members have complete faith in their comrades and their capabilities. The presence of openly LGBTQ+ individuals might lead to preconceptions, skepticism, or mistrust between soldiers, undermining the perception of battlefield competence.

An example from history, the ancient Spartan warriors, underlines this idea. Spartans exclusively fought alongside their fellow soldiers with whom they shared the strictest social bonds. This cohesion allowed them to execute military maneuvers with unparalleled efficiency. Reinstating the ban on openly LGBTQ+ service members would thus contribute to a more focused and efficient military force, prepared to face and overcome any challenge.

Conclusion

In conclusion, reinstating the ban on openly LGBTQ+ individuals serving in the United States military is not a step towards discrimination, but a step towards ensuring a strong, cohesive, and effective fighting force. When evaluating changes in military policy, the overall effectiveness and preparedness of our troops should always be the priority.

Unit cohesion, morale, and combat readiness are indispensable factors that must be maintained at all costs to guarantee the continued superiority of the United States military. As a collective whole, they far outweigh the benefits of an inclusive policy that allows openly LGBTQ+ service members in the ranks.
